author: KEXP
description: Australia's Cut Copy make a return to warm, colorful, New Wave-tinted synth pop anthems on their latest release 'Moments'. Lighting up the KEXP Studio with infectious grooves and melancholic melodies, the band share a buoyant performance of "Still See Love" and more.
title: Cut Copy performs "Still See Love" & more Live on KEXP
